scouting.summary: Stays long and kicks: teeps to keep you out, then body and leg kicks. Circles off when you close in.
strengths: Good footwork: hard to pin down
weaknesses: Stands on one leg every time he kicks
scouting.tell: When his jab gets blocked he follows with a right body kick, most of the time.
scouting.how_to_beat: Close the distance and make him fight in the pocket. Call the catch-kick when the body kick comes.
